# Quick2Learn — Comprehensive Institute Knowledge Base

> Canonical URL: https://quick2learn.in
> Primary Focus: Mathematics & Science Coaching for Classes IX, X, XI, XII (CBSE & ICSE/ISC)
> Location: Mathura, Uttar Pradesh 281004, India

---

## 1. Overview & Institute Identity
Quick2Learn is Mathura's foremost coaching academy dedicated to senior secondary and high school education in Mathematics and the Natural Sciences. Founded by veteran educator Dinesh Singh Rajput and co-led by Namita Singh Rajput, the institute bridges fundamental theoretical understanding with rigorous board examination strategies.

- Founded by: Dinesh Singh Rajput (25+ Years Experience)
- Faculty Leadership:
  - Dinesh Singh Rajput — Senior Mathematics Educator & Director
  - Namita Singh Rajput — Senior Chemistry & Biology Specialist
- Accreditation & Board Alignment: CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education) & ICSE/ISC (Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations)
- Campuses & Mode: Offline Classroom Batches in Mathura, UP, combined with interactive digital learning and video lecture archives.

---

## 2. Distinctive Honors & Recognitions
- 25+ Years of unbroken excellence in board mathematics education.
- Awarded "Best Teacher Award" (2015).
- Recognized with the "Teacher Innovation Award" (2019).
- Special Commendation by the Union Minister of Human Resource Development (HRD Minister), Government of India, for outstanding CBSE results (2015).
- Multiple students achieving perfect scores (100/100) in CBSE Class 10 & 12 Board Examinations annually.

---

## 3. Academic Programs & Curriculum

### Class IX (CBSE & ICSE)
- Mathematics: Number Systems, Polynomials, Coordinate Geometry, Linear Equations, Euclid's Geometry, Triangles, Quadrilaterals, Circles, Heron's Formula, Surface Areas & Volumes, Statistics.
- Science: Physics (Motion, Force & Laws of Motion, Gravitation, Work & Energy, Sound), Chemistry (Matter in Our Surroundings, Is Matter Around Us Pure, Atoms & Molecules, Structure of the Atom), Biology (Cell - Fundamental Unit of Life, Tissues, Improvement in Food Resources).
- Additional ICSE subjects: Hindi, History & Civics foundation.

### Class X (CBSE & ICSE)
- Mathematics: Real Numbers, Polynomials, Pair of Linear Equations, Quadratic Equations, Arithmetic Progressions, Triangles, Coordinate Geometry, Trigonometry, Applications of Trigonometry, Circles, Areas Related to Circles, Surface Areas & Volumes, Statistics, Probability.
- Science: Complete coverage of Physics, Chemistry, Biology with dedicated laboratory concept walk-throughs and previous years question (PYQ) workshops.

### Class XI (CBSE & State Boards)
- Mathematics: Sets, Relations & Functions, Trigonometric Functions, Complex Numbers, Linear Inequalities, Permutations & Combinations, Binomial Theorem, Sequences & Series, Straight Lines, Conic Sections, Introduction to 3D Geometry, Limits & Derivatives, Statistics, Probability.
- Physics: Mechanics, Waves, Thermodynamics, Properties of Matter.
- Chemistry: Physical, Inorganic, and Organic Chemistry fundamentals.

### Class XII (CBSE & ISC)
- Mathematics: Relations & Functions, Inverse Trigonometric Functions, Matrices, Determinants, Continuity & Differentiability, Application of Derivatives, Integrals, Applications of Integrals, Differential Equations, Vector Algebra, Three Dimensional Geometry, Linear Programming, Probability.
- Board Booster batches, chapter-wise intensive test series, full-syllabus mock exams.
